name: Ocelus

attributes.attribute: known from only a few inscriptions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ocelus was a Welsh and British god. The obscurity of this deity is complete, for only a few inscriptions name him. The Romans linked him with Mars.

okr.objective: Ocelus is an obscure god of Wales and Britain.
key_results: Only a few inscriptions record his name.
The Romans connected him with Mars.
His myth and cult remain unknown.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
